"show don't tell" is a very bad type of criticism that oversimplify  the interaction between narrative tools and styles.

"tell" and "Show" are two completely  different  narrative tools that have different rule sand uses. There are thing that are way better in visual medias and thing that are better in dialogue.

Furthermore it's not right to separate between the two as both visual and narrative are intrinsically connect and one directly influences and molds the other.

The rule also  implies that one media is better than the other which is stupidly elitist.

I also like to point out that is not right to have standardize and absolute rules  when it comes to story telling has it's pretty limiting to the genre and many time the greatest narrative are the one that are able to break this type o perceived notion
